positioning_text: Rehlko is the former Kohler Energy business, majority owned by Platinum Equity since May 2024 and rebranded in September 2024, with Kohler Co. retained as an investment partner. Its large genset play is the in-house KD Series (Liebherr-built engines, 800 kW to 4,500 kVA at 50 Hz and up to 4,000 kW at 60 Hz) built at Brest, France and Changzhou, China, and positioned hard at hyperscale data centres. In KSA, UAE and Kuwait it sells through Midis Group affiliates (MMR in Riyadh, Site & Power and Mideast Data Systems in the UAE, Site and Power Kuwait) plus Abunayyan Trading in Riyadh, supported by an SDMO Industries Middle East office and warehouse in Dubai. Clarke Energy, its gas engine arm, has no Gulf office as of September 2026.

movements.headline: Kohler Energy rebrands as Rehlko under Platinum Equity ownership
movements.summary: Platinum Equity completed its acquisition of a majority stake in May 2024 and the business took the Rehlko name on 17 September 2024, with Kohler Co. remaining an investment partner. Portfolio listed as Power Systems, Engines, Uninterruptible Power, Home Energy, Clarke Energy, Curtis Instruments and Heila Technologies, across 100 plus locations.

relevance.analysis: Private equity ownership means Rehlko is being run for growth and exit, with capital allocated to data centre gensets. The Kohler-SDMO brand equity in the Gulf is being migrated to Rehlko, which creates a window where distributor and end-user recognition is weaker. Cummins Arabia should press its brand continuity with consultants and data centre EPCs during this transition.

movements.headline: Rehlko and Liebherr expand KD Series engine partnership
movements.summary: Rehlko announced an expanded partnership with Liebherr for next generation KD Series generators, securing engine supply for the range that competes with Cummins QSK series in the 1 MW to 4 MW band.

relevance.analysis: The KD engine is a Liebherr-derived design, so Rehlko depends on a single external engine partner for its flagship range. Cummins Arabia can position Cummins in-house engine design, manufacturing and Gulf parts stock as a supply certainty argument in tenders.

movements.headline: Rehlko completes acquisition of The Wilmott Group (WB Power Services and Wiltech Acoustics)
movements.summary: UK critical power integrator with 19 UK locations supporting over 4,000 critical power plants joined Rehlko, adding project engineering, acoustic enclosures and lifecycle service to its EMEA data centre offer.

relevance.analysis: Rehlko is building an end-to-end data centre delivery model in EMEA (engineering, enclosures, commissioning, service) rather than selling loose gensets. Gulf hyperscale customers procuring through UK and European consultants will see this offer. Cummins Arabia should be ready to quote full turnkey scope, not equipment only.

movements.headline: Rehlko and Alghanem deliver data centre backup power in Jordan
movements.summary: DCD reported a Jordan data centre backup power project delivered by Rehlko with Alghanem Trading and Contracting, its exclusive Jordan distributor for over 25 years. Capacity and models were not published. The article also states Rehlko ranks third globally in generator manufacturing.

relevance.analysis: This is the closest published Rehlko data centre reference to the Gulf. It shows Rehlko using long-tenured regional distributors for data centre wins in the Levant. The same Midis Group channel that serves Jordan also serves KSA, UAE and Kuwait, so replication in the Gulf is plausible.

movements.headline: Rehlko launches all-new KD Series 60 to 600 kW generators
movements.summary: Rehlko extended the KD brand down into the 60 to 600 kW range, presenting it as a global standard in 80 to 600 kW power and consolidating its industrial lineup under one brand.

relevance.analysis: Below 600 kW is outside the large genset band but this unifies Rehlko's catalogue for distributors, which simplifies their selling and service story in the Gulf. Cummins Arabia's C-series coverage in the same band remains broader, and it should hold price discipline rather than react.

movements.headline: Rehlko and INNIO sign multi-year framework for 1.25 GW of gas engines
movements.summary: Three-year framework agreement allocating 1.25 GW of INNIO gas engine capacity to Rehlko, delivered through Clarke Energy as integrated gas genset plus BESS hybrid solutions for hyperscale, colocation and enterprise data centres and flexible generation in constrained grids, within Clarke Energy's authorised territories.

relevance.analysis: The agreement is confined to Clarke Energy territories, and Clarke Energy lists no office in KSA, UAE or Kuwait. Gulf gas genset demand from data centres and grid constrained sites therefore has no Rehlko gas channel today. Cummins Arabia should push HSK78G and gas genset packages into Gulf data centre and utility bids before Rehlko or another INNIO packager fills that gap.

movements.headline: Rehlko secures another 1.7 GW of hyperscale backup power orders in 60 days
movements.summary: Orders for diesel modular backup generator solutions across multiple North American hyperscale campuses, using repeatable system architectures and standardised delivery models.

relevance.analysis: Rehlko is converting its data centre strategy into gigawatt scale orders and will carry those hyperscaler relationships into the Gulf as the same operators build in KSA and UAE. Cummins Arabia should map which hyperscalers have standardised on Rehlko in North America and pre-empt their Gulf procurement with local stock, 60 Hz KSA references and service coverage.

movements.headline: Rehlko introduces next-generation APM804 control platform
movements.summary: New controller aimed at the complexity, scale and resilience requirements of modern data centres; APM804 now appears as a standard controller option on KD spec sheets.

relevance.analysis: Controls and paralleling are a decision factor for data centre consultants. Cummins Arabia should ensure PowerCommand paralleling and monitoring capabilities are presented head to head with APM804 in consultant briefings.

movements.headline: Rehlko opens Kenosha, Wisconsin assembly for eFRAME enclosures up to 4 MW
movements.summary: New facility for integrated eFRAME enclosures for backup generator solutions up to 4 MW, with plans to expand capacity by more than 400% through the decade; initial production late 2026, full capacity early 2027.

relevance.analysis: Capacity is being added for enclosed 4 MW packages, the format hyperscalers specify. This is North American capacity, so lead time relief for Gulf orders would come from Brest and Changzhou instead. Cummins Arabia should track quoted lead times from Rehlko distributors on 2.5 MW to 4 MW enclosed sets.

movements.headline: Rehlko integrates WB Power Services into its UK and EMEA platform
movements.summary: WB Power Services, acquired August 2025, was integrated into a unified Rehlko EMEA operating model spanning design, installation, testing and service. Lenaik Andrieux named as General Manager EMEA, India and LATAM.

relevance.analysis: The EMEA leadership now runs a standardised delivery model that can be extended to the Middle East through distributors. Cummins Arabia should expect more consistent Rehlko bids on Gulf data centre tenders led by UK and European consultants.

movements.headline: Liebherr expands Colmar engine plant for Rehlko KD Series data centre demand
movements.summary: Ceremony at Liebherr-Components Colmar marked a nearly 12,000 square metre extension; engine production capacity for Rehlko will more than double once fully ramped. Rehlko cited a growing backlog to convert into long-term revenue.

relevance.analysis: Engine supply was the constraint on KD Series volume. Doubling it removes a lead time argument Cummins Arabia could previously use in the 2 MW to 4 MW band. Expect more aggressive KD availability quotes into Gulf data centre projects from 2027.

movements.headline: Rehlko invests EUR 12 million to expand Cholet, France switchgear plant
movements.summary: 56% expansion of manufacturing space over five years, 30% lead time reduction on completion in November 2026, over 100 new jobs; Cholet builds LV main switchboards, generator switchboards and control panels for data centre solutions.

relevance.analysis: Rehlko is shortening lead times on the paralleling switchgear that ships with large genset packages to EMEA including the Gulf. Cummins Arabia should quantify its own switchgear lead times and partner capacity so it is not outpaced on complete package delivery.

movements.headline: Rehlko launches programme to double Changzhou backup power capacity from 5.5 GW to 11 GW
movements.summary: Changzhou builds generator systems from 6 kW to 4,000 kW and key components, serving China, Southeast Asia, EMEA and Latin America; CEO called it a critical hub for EMEA. The 11 GW target is to be reached without expanding the footprint; first pass yield up from 93% to 98%.

relevance.analysis: Changzhou explicitly serves EMEA, so Gulf distributors can now source KD Series up to 4,000 kW from a plant with 11 GW annual capacity. This is a direct supply and price lever against Cummins Arabia in KSA, UAE and Kuwait data centre and industrial tenders. Cummins Arabia should benchmark Changzhou-sourced pricing on 1.5 MW to 3 MW sets and reinforce total cost of ownership and local service arguments.

partnerships.partner: Midis Group (MMR KSA, MDS Site & Power UAE, Mideast Data Systems, Site and Power Kuwait)
partnerships.scope: Kohler-SDMO / Rehlko industrial genset distribution, installation and service; MDS Energy describes exclusive partnership with Kohler and Vertiv; MDS SI Group has 2,600 plus staff and 60 affiliates across the Middle East and Turkey

why_it_matters.analysis: Midis bundles Rehlko gensets with Vertiv UPS and cooling in one data centre proposal across all three Cummins Arabia countries. That single-vendor site package is attractive to colocation and telecom customers (Mobily, Ooredoo, Omantel are listed references). Cummins Arabia should build equivalent alliances with UPS and cooling vendors or partner with data centre integrators to neutralise the bundle.

partnerships.scope: Authorised distributor for industrial gensets, service and parts in Saudi Arabia per Rehlko EMEA locator

why_it_matters.analysis: A second Saudi channel gives Rehlko reach into Abunayyan Group's utility, water and industrial customer base. Cummins Arabia should watch for KD Series offers in SEC and water sector tenders where Abunayyan has relationships.

partnerships.scope: Supplies KD Series engines; Colmar plant extension of nearly 12,000 square metres will more than double capacity for Rehlko

why_it_matters.analysis: Removes the engine supply ceiling on KD Series. Cummins Arabia loses a lead time advantage in the 2 MW to 4 MW data centre band from 2027 onward.

partnerships.scope: 1.25 GW of gas engines over three years, delivered via Clarke Energy in its authorised territories, for data centre and flexible generation hybrids with BESS

why_it_matters.analysis: Clarke Energy has no Gulf territory, so this gas capacity does not reach KSA, UAE or Kuwait through Rehlko. Cummins Arabia can lead on gas gensets for Gulf data centres and industrial CHP while that channel gap exists.

partnerships.scope: S16R and S16R2 engines in Kohler-SDMO T Series (T1650, T2200C, T2500-E) still listed in the Rehlko EMEA catalogue

why_it_matters.analysis: Rehlko still offers Mitsubishi-engined 1.6 MVA to 2.5 MVA sets in EMEA alongside KD Series, which means Gulf buyers may meet the same S16R engine under two competitor brands. Cummins Arabia should differentiate on Cummins engine service network rather than engine to engine specs.

partnerships.scope: Exclusive Rehlko distributor in Jordan for over 25 years; delivered data centre backup power project in 2025

why_it_matters.analysis: Levant reference for Rehlko data centre delivery. Not in Cummins Arabia's territory, but Jordanian data centre operators and consultants also work in KSA.
